ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) background with approximately 15-20% low-intensity (black) distribution concentrated on trailing margins and internal spotting.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Ventral surface is dominated by a central white field. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous, jagged band along the trailing edge of the right lobe. Distinct black pixel clusters (mottling) are present on the upper-left quadrant near the leading edge and the upper-right quadrant near the trailing edge tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees and high bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The right lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations (jagged peaks). The left lobe trailing edge displays lower frequency serrations, partially occluded by water spray at the base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both trailing edges follow a concave trajectory toward the median notch. Leading edges exhibit a continuous convex sweep terminating in acute, barnacle-encrusted tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast yellowish-brown and white pixel clusters (barnacles) localized along the leading edge margins and distal tips. Small, circular, faint greyish-white desaturated spots are visible on the central-right white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, dark, curved parallel linear pixel disruptions located in the lower-central region of the right lobe, and one vertical dark line near the right trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological colonization (barnacles) along the entire leading edge boundary. A notable irregular excision or deep notch on the right lobe trailing edge approximately 15% from the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A complex arrangement of black 'comma-shaped' and circular pigmentation marks in the lower-right lobe quadrant, forming a unique identification pattern.
